body:
Considering the difficulty of finding these even for experience code reviewers, I would remove these from being L1 requirements.

Also, I think there is an intermixing of two different things:

- malicious code within the application (backdoors, etc.)
- malicious activity by someone attacking the application

This section doesn't clearly differentiate the two and 14.0 (which should be 13.x) feels out of place.  If you have an attacker already exploiting malicious code, then you probably aren't looking at sandboxing, containerization, etc. but more at removing it as soon as possible and possibly virtually patching it until you can remove it.
